title: OwnGenome sample summary (bin/collect_summary.py)
description: Both reports are rendered from this file. og dev schema checks a summary against it.

clinvar_condition.description: The conditions ClinVar names for the allele (CLNDN), joined by ' / ', without 'not provided' and 'not specified'; null when no other name is left. Present only when step 06's hits carry CLNDN or CLNDISDB.

clinvar_condition_ids.description: The database ids of those conditions (CLNDISDB), such as OMIM:171400, and of a condition CLNDISDB gives with no CLNDN name; not those of 'not provided' and 'not specified'.

incomplete.description: Genes whose call rests on positions PharmCAT never read; written only when there is one.
